Our Services

Complete Roofing Solutions, Delivered Right.

Whether it's a small repair or a full re-roof, every job is treated with the same standard of workmanship — quality materials, tidy work, and honest pricing.

Full Re-Roofs

Complete strip-and-relay roofing using quality tiles, slates, membranes and battens. Built to last with manufacturer-backed materials and proven techniques.

Roof Repairs

Slipped tiles, missing slates, leaks, storm damage and emergency call-outs. Fast, reliable repairs that solve the problem properly — not just patch it.

Chimneys & Leadwork

Chimney repointing, rebuilds, lead flashing replacement and cowls. Skilled traditional craft work to weatherproof the trickiest parts of your roof.

Gutters, Fascias & Soffits

Full UPVC and aluminium installations, replacements, repairs and cleaning. Keep water moving away from your home and protect your brickwork.

Flat Roofing

EPDM rubber, GRP fibreglass and felt systems for extensions, garages and dormers. Long-life waterproofing with professional installation.

Roofline & Maintenance

Moss removal, ridge tile rebedding, dry verge systems and full roof inspections. Keep your roof in top condition year after year.

Why Choose KL Roofing

Honest Tradesmen.
Properly Done Work.

We're a local Worcester roofing firm that believes in doing things the right way — no cut corners, no surprise costs, no chasing for callbacks.

01

Local & Trusted

Based in Worcester (WR2 5LX) and serving the surrounding areas. We rely on local reputation and word-of-mouth, so every job matters.

02

Free, Honest Quotes

Clear, written quotes with no hidden extras. We tell you what's needed, what's not, and what it'll cost — upfront.

03

Quality Materials

We work with proven, manufacturer-backed materials. The right tile, the right membrane, the right flashing for the job.

04

Tidy Site, Tidy Finish

Properly scaffolded, dust-sheeted where needed, and a clean clear-up at the end. You'll barely know we were there — apart from the roof.

05

Workmanship Guarantee

All major work backed by a 10-year workmanship guarantee in addition to manufacturer warranties on materials. Peace of mind built in.

06

Public liability insured for your protection and ours. Working at height done safely, properly, and to current regulations.
